text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During Vivlos's training, her older sister 
Verxina came to observe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Running the Tiara route will only make 
people compare my little sister to me, 
forcing her to carry the burden of what I 
couldn't achieve," she fretted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Contrary to those thoughts, Vivlos was 
firmly determined to win the Triple Tiara 
her sister couldn't, all to bring a smile 
to her sister's face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Learning of Vivlos's determination, 
Verxina entrusted her younger sister to 
the Trainer.
